description: Kinetic stacked type: condensed uppercase words stacked one per line slam in from alternating sides with motion blur, an accent bar grows beside them, one highlighted word in the accent colour; words drop out on exit. Hooks, hype moments, statements. Transparent.

params.text: Words, one per line (| to group several words on a line), e.g. 'MOTION|BRINGS|STORIES.'
params.highlight: Comma-separated words painted in the accent colour
params.position: center | left | right | bottom-left | top-left ... (default left)
params.background: Solid background used only for opaque .mp4 output
